questions.question: When will I get paid for each milestone?
expectedAnchors: the Client shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receiving it

questions.question: If Orchid Lane cancels the project halfway, will I be paid for the work I have already done?
expectedAnchors: no payment shall be due for work in progress or for Deliverables not yet accepted

questions.question: Do I keep the rights to my designs until the client pays me?
expectedAnchors: whether or not the Fees for them have been paid

questions.question: How many rounds of revisions am I required to do?
expectedAnchors: until the Client is satisfied with them, at no additional cost

questions.question: As a freelancer in India, when do I need to register for GST?
A client has not paid my invoice for three months. What can I do as a freelance designer?
Is the 12-month non-compete in this agreement enforceable against me?
expectedAnchors: shall not provide design or development services to any business engaged in the manufacture or sale of packaged foods, snacks or beverages in India
questions.note: Asked with the agreement attached (grounded, so outside the routing bar): 'non-compete' is also an employment keyword; the restraint is in a freelance contract.

questions.question: Can my client stop me from showing their project in my portfolio if the contract says nothing about it?
questions.note: A freelancer's portfolio right (freelance) that turns on contract silence and IP (contracts_nda).

questions.question: The startup I freelance for wants to hire me full-time with a 90-day notice period. What should I check in the offer letter before signing?
questions.note: 'freelance' is a distractor; the question is about an employment offer.

questions.question: A startup I designed a logo for is using it without paying me, and says our contract was never signed. Can I stop them from using my design?
questions.note: 'contract' is a distractor; the question is about unpaid freelance work and who owns it.
